meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images using AI models (FLUX, Nano Banana 2). Use for general-purpose image generation including photos, illustrations, artwork, visual assets, concept art, and any image that is not a technical diagram or schematic. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成或编辑各类图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成照片、插画或艺术作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images using AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate photos, illustrations, or artwork

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude能通过脚本调用AI模型（如FLUX.2 Pro、Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview）生成或编辑图像。你描述画面或编辑要求，它输出PNG图片文件。
howto.when: 当你要求生成通用图像（照片、插画、概念图等），或要求编辑已有图片时触发。技术图表（流程图、电路图等）请用其他技能。

say.text: 生成一张夕阳下的山脉照片。
say.note: 将根据提示生成图片并保存。

say.text: 把这张肖像画的光线调亮一些。
用Gemini模型画一幅未来城市概念图。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can generate or edit images by running a script that calls AI models (e.g., FLUX.2 Pro, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview). Describe the image or editing instructions, and it produces a PNG file.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you ask Claude to generate a general-purpose image (photo, illustration, concept art, etc.) or edit an existing image. For technical diagrams, use the 'scientific-schematics' skill instead.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a sunset over mountains.
say_en.note: Creates a PNG file based on the prompt.

say_en.text: Brighten the lighting in this portrait.
Use Gemini model to draw a futuristic city concept.
